root_cause: Canonical Powerhouse differentiates actions, verified outcomes and learning but the owner journey did not project their distinct confidence and causal states together; repeated outcome identities could inflate a naive aggregate.

observed_evidence.data_kind: Tenant-scoped owner projection, current Brain operating-loop observability, verified outcome/learning evidence

failed_approaches: Treat a delivered action as a verified customer business outcome
Count learning without independent learning evidence and next decision
Count duplicated outcome IDs multiple times
Treat old Brain runtime as proof of current autonomous execution
fix: Read-only autopilot evidence from original tenant-scoped owner model; require outcome ID, healthy source proof and independent verified outcome status, deduplicate exact IDs, then require learning_verified, learning_evidence_refs and next_decision_id for a demonstrated learning chain.
prevention_rule: An agent or portal must never report realized customer value or completed autonomous execution from a proposal, approval, deployment, provider ack, stale runtime, demo tenant, duplicate outcome or forecast. A learned decision requires verified outcome, learning proof and a linked next decision; suppress numeric assertions when scope is unproven. Reuse original Brain/Powerhouse/Heartbeat, consent policy and incident register; no extra scheduler, duplicate learning authority or relaxed CI/CodeQL gates.

invariants: No claimed autonomous execution from proposals
No learning without outcome and learning and next decision

required: two real authenticated tenant A/B verifications
